posts.title: Fixing Multi-GPU performance, part 1
posts.description: Performance on “secondary” GPUs has historically been suboptimal on Linux, especially with external GPUs. Let’s take a look at why it’s slow, and how we’re finally fixing it.

posts.title: Display Next Hackfest 2026
posts.description: This year, there was another display next hackfest, this time in Nice, France. This was a very productive hackfest, so I’ll focus just on my personal highlights here.

posts.title: Making wl_shm fast
posts.description: While most new applications use the GPU for rendering to achieve better performance and battery life, there are some new applications and a lot of older applications that still use CPU rendering. More specifically relevant for KDE, while QtQuick is GPU accelerated, QtWidgets uses CPU rendering.
